findings.title: Derived website name bypasses TL0 profile-field restrictions
findings.body: `website_name` is serialized independently of `website` and is not included in `untrusted_attributes`. For a trust-level-0 user viewed anonymously, `include_website?` suppresses the website URL, but the new attribute is still emitted and contains the website host and, for matching instance domains, the full path. The profile page will render that value even though the underlying website field is intentionally hidden, leaking restricted profile information. Apply the same visibility predicate to `website_name` (for example by adding it to `untrusted_attributes`) and add a TL0-with-website serialization test.

findings.title: Website-name inclusion predicate is misnamed and never used
findings.body: ActiveModel serializer inclusion predicates use the `include_<attribute>?` method name, as elsewhere in this serializer. This defines `include_website_name` without the question mark, so it is ignored and `website_name` is serialized for every response, including as `null` when no website exists. Rename it to `include_website_name?` so the newly introduced field follows the intended optional-attribute contract.
